aggregation_rule: Binding/security failure => BLOCK; another required failure => FAIL; otherwise manual NOT_RUN => NOT_RUN; only all required checks PASS => PASS.

blocking_failure.route: Resolve the fixture-policy Decision Gate, then either rebind and revalidate A1 through A3 or restore the prior DomainSpec fixture through its owner.
blocking_failure.claim: All three pinned DomainSpec expected outputs have coordinated uncommitted changes; A1 correctly rejects them until ownership is resolved.
